items.exampleEn: The peacock is the national bird of India.
After the festival, the street was covered in detritus.
items.exampleZh: 節慶結束後，街上滿是垃圾碎屑。

items.exampleEn: The ewe stayed close to her newborn lamb.
items.exampleZh: 那隻母羊緊緊守在剛出生的小羊旁邊。

items.exampleEn: Some frogs survive the winter in hibernation under the mud.
items.exampleZh: 有些青蛙躲在泥巴底下冬眠，度過冬天。

items.exampleEn: Some snakes hibernate in groups under large rocks.
items.exampleZh: 有些蛇會成群躲在大石頭底下冬眠。

items.exampleEn: Hedgehogs eat insects and snails in the garden.
items.exampleZh: 刺蝟會吃花園裡的昆蟲和蝸牛。

items.exampleEn: A heifer is a young cow that has not had a calf.
items.exampleZh: 小母牛是指還沒生過小牛的年輕母牛。

items.exampleEn: After the swim, her hair hung damply around her face.
items.exampleZh: 游完泳後，她的頭髮濕答答地垂在臉旁。

items.sentenceEn: Bears hibernate through the long winter months.
items.sentenceZh: 熊會冬眠，度過漫長的冬季。

items.audioEn: The peacock spread its colorful tail feathers to attract attention.
items.audioZh: 那隻孔雀展開色彩繽紛的尾羽來吸引注意。
options: It opened its bright tail feathers

items.sentenceEn: A hedgehog curls into a ball when it feels danger.
items.sentenceZh: 刺蝟感覺到危險時，會縮成一顆球。

items.sentenceEn: The farmer sold three young heifers at the market.
items.sentenceZh: 農夫在市場賣了三頭小母牛。

items.stemEn: Before winter, the animal eats a lot to prepare for ____.
items.stemZh: 入冬前，這種動物會吃很多東西，為冬眠做準備。

items.stemEn: The farmer cut the wool from each ____ before the summer heat.
items.stemZh: 夏天變熱之前，農夫把每隻母羊的毛剪下來。

items.passageEn: Our class spent a wet autumn morning at a small farm outside town. The farmer showed us her ewes and a young heifer that had just arrived. A proud peacock walked around the yard, and the children laughed when it showed off its feathers. Behind the barn, next to the small orchard, the farmer pointed to a pile of leaves and other garden detritus. "A hedgehog sleeps in there every winter," she explained. "During its hibernation, we never move the pile." By lunchtime, the children's coats were hanging damply on the chairs, but nobody wanted to leave.
items.passageZh: 我們班在一個下雨的秋天早晨，去了城外的一座小農場。農場主人給我們看她的母羊，還有一頭剛來的小母牛。一隻得意的孔雀在院子裡踱步，牠一開屏，孩子們就笑了。在穀倉後面、小果園旁邊，農場主人指著一堆落葉和其他花園碎屑。她解釋：「每年冬天都有一隻刺蝟睡在裡面。牠冬眠的期間，我們從來不動那堆葉子。」到了午餐時間，孩子們的外套濕答答地掛在椅子上，但沒有人想離開。

questions.questionZh: 農場主人在穀倉後面指著什麼？
options: 剛出生的一群可愛小羊

questions.questionZh: 為什麼冬天從來不動那堆葉子？
options: 葉子要留到春天當肥料
孩子們喜歡在上面玩耍

items.promptZh: 冬眠期間，刺蝟的心跳會變得很慢。
referenceEn: During hibernation, a hedgehog's heart beats very slowly.
A hedgehog's heart rate becomes very slow during hibernation.
rubricZh: hibernation 是名詞，表示「冬眠」，用法例如 during hibernation、in hibernation 等
「心跳變慢」可寫，例如 the heart beats slowly、the heart rate slows down 等

items.instructionZh: 用 peacock 造一個句子，說說你看過孔雀的地方或經驗。
referenceEn: I once saw a white peacock at the zoo in Taipei.
When I visited the park, a peacock walked right past me.
rubricZh: peacock 是可數名詞，表示「孔雀」（例如 a peacock、a white peacock 等）
句子要說到你自己的經驗
時態配合內容（例如 saw、walked 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：「A hedgehog's heart becomes very slow」不道地（心臟本身不會 slow），應為 heartbeat／heart rate becomes very slow；rubricZh/1 的「the heart becomes slow」同樣要改。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 參考答案改 heart rate becomes very slow；評分要點同步改 the heart rate slows down

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：mcq 與 ewe 卡同主詞、同情境（母羊和小羊）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題幹改 The farmer cut the wool from each ____ before the summer heat.，代入後只有 ewe 成立

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：「The morning grass shone damply in the sun.」shone damply 搭配生硬，可考慮 The towels hung damply on the line. 之類較自然的用法。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改 After the swim, her hair hung damply around her face.（與閱讀的外套情境錯開）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：hibernation 是名詞，表示「冬眠」，用法例如 during hibernation、in hibernation 等／「心跳變慢」可寫，例如 the heart beats slowly、the heart rate slows down 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：peacock 是可數名詞，表示「孔雀」（例如 a peacock、a white peacock 等）／句子要說到你自己的經驗／時態配合內容（例如 saw、walked 等）
